difficulty_reason: Given xi = (Z, u', hat x) versal at v_0: if v_0 not in Z, shrink to V setminus Z where versality is smoothness of u'; if v_0 in Z, lemma-openness-smoothness makes hat x smooth, hence x' : V' -> X' smooth along the preimage of Z by the lifting-along-Artinian lemma; the non-smooth locus B of x' is closed in |V'|, misses (V' -> V)^{-1}(Z), and maps to a closed subset of V missing Z since V' -> V is proper, so shrinking V empties B and xi is versal at every finite type point.
